**Checklist for testing**
**Please verify the following in production:**

***1\. Validating referral codes***

[ACCOUNT_001] Review the dashboard — it should list only successful mints

[ACCOUNT_001] If you are the owner, the "*View Book*" button should appear

***4\. Badges***
[ACCOUNT_001] Review the dashboard badges section — it should contain 8 badges (Legend removed). Keep in mind that the badge display is responsive, so it is determined by the screen size

Every fix is live and available for testing.
